categories.main_business_segments: Jiangsu Yunyi Electric Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the automotive intelligent core electronics sector, focusing on the research, development, production, and sales of automotive intelligent power controllers, intelligent wiper systems, sensor products, new energy connection components, and semiconductor power devices. The company also engages in photovoltaic power generation projects through its subsidiaries. Its business segments include automotive electronics, power, and other related products.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced semiconductor technology, FOC control algorithms for micro motor controllers, ceramic chip technology for sensors, and AI-driven design algorithms for intelligent wiper systems. It employs vertically integrated manufacturing processes including mold design, mechanical processing, injection molding, automated assembly, and product testing. Digital systems such as ERP, MES, WMS, and SRM support its smart manufacturing and supply chain integration, enabling flexible and scalable production aligned with Industry 4.0 standards.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major domestic and international automotive manufacturers such as Changan Ford, SAIC General Motors, BYD, BMW, Mercedes-Benz, Audi, and leading Tier 1 suppliers like Bosch and Denso. The company serves both OEM and aftermarket segments, with a growing presence in new energy vehicle manufacturers and overseas markets. Its products are integrated into passenger vehicles, commercial vehicles, and new energy vehicles, addressing global automotive electronics demand.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters and manufacturing facilities in Jiangsu Province. It has expanded its global footprint through subsidiaries in Malaysia and Hong Kong, and actively develops overseas markets including Europe and Southeast Asia. The company’s products are supplied to international automotive OEMs and Tier 1 suppliers, reflecting a broad geographic coverage across Asia, Europe, and other global regions.
categories.supply_chain_position: Jiangsu Yunyi Electric occupies a midstream to downstream position in the automotive supply chain, focusing on the design, manufacturing, and supply of core electronic components and modules to automotive OEMs and Tier 1 suppliers. It integrates upstream activities such as semiconductor chip development and precision injection molding, enabling vertical integration and control over key component quality and costs.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in automotive intelligent electronics, emphasizing R&D in intelligent power controllers, brushless motor control, AI-driven wiper system design, and high-temperature ceramic sensor chips. It invests heavily in new energy vehicle components like charging guns and high-voltage connectors, and advances semiconductor power device technologies. Digital transformation, process optimization, and global market expansion are key strategic pillars, supported by a robust patent portfolio and collaboration with global chip manufacturers.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct product sales of automotive electronic components and systems to OEMs, Tier 1 suppliers, and aftermarket customers. The company also earns income from photovoltaic power generation projects and investment returns. Sales contracts are typically long-term framework agreements with annual supply commitments, with revenue recognized upon transfer of control based on delivery and acceptance criteria.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Jiangsu Yunyi Electric is positioned as a leading domestic player and industry leader in automotive intelligent core electronics in China, with a growing global presence. It competes with international automotive electronics suppliers and Tier 1 component manufacturers. The company differentiates itself through vertical integration, advanced technology, and strong customer relationships with top global OEMs and suppliers, maintaining a competitive edge in smart automotive electronics and new energy vehicle components.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 2.15 billion, representing a 28.35% year-over-year increase, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 401 million, up 31.51%. It has demonstrated consistent growth driven by expanding market share, new product development, and overseas market penetration. Total assets reached over RMB 4 billion with an 8.15% increase from the prior year, reflecting steady scale expansion and operational efficiency improvements.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company offers differentiated value through its deep technological expertise in intelligent automotive electronics, vertical integration of key components, and strong R&D capabilities. Its products provide enhanced safety, reliability, and performance, supported by proprietary algorithms and advanced materials technology. The company emphasizes cost competitiveness, rapid customer response, and quality assurance, enabling it to secure strategic partnerships with leading global automotive manufacturers and accelerate import substitution in China.
